title: Notes on countable frames
summary: Matthew de Brecht raised the question of whether countable frames are continuous lattices. We prove that the continuity of a countable frame implies the quasicontinuity of its corresponding spectrum in the dual specialization order. We further show that this question admits a positive answer if the frame's spectrum is a $T_1$ space or a Scott space. In general, we confirm the existence of non-continuous countable frames.
